abstract: Workflows for running Postgres with clickhousectl, covering both local and cloud. Local: Docker-backed Postgres instances for development — start, psql client, .env wiring, lifecycle. Cloud: managed ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services (beta) — authentication, service creation, connections and TLS, runtime configuration, read replicas, failover, and point-in-time restore. Migration: moving an existing Postgres (Neon, Supabase, RDS, ...) into ClickHouse Cloud Postgres with pg_dump/pg_restore. The top-level skill routes between ref/local.md, ref/cloud.md, and ref/migrate.md, and the local workflow hands off to cloud when going to production.
